stdout:
gnunet-arm
Control services and the Automated Restart Manager (ARM)
Arguments mandatory for long options are also mandatory for short options.
  -a, --all                  also show stopped services (used with -I)
  -c, --config=FILENAME      use configuration file FILENAME
  -d, --delete               delete config file and directory on exit
  -E, --no-stderr            don't let gnunet-service-arm inherit standard
                               error
  -e, --end                  stop all GNUnet services
  -h, --help                 print this help
  -I, --info                 list currently running services
  -i, --init=SERVICE         start a particular service
  -k, --kill=SERVICE         stop a particular service
  -L, --log=LOGLEVEL         configure logging to use LOGLEVEL
  -l, --logfile=FILENAME     configure logging to write logs to FILENAME
  -m, --monitor              monitor ARM activities
  -O, --no-stdout            don't let gnunet-service-arm inherit standard
                               output
  -q, --quiet                don't print status messages
  -r, --restart              stop and start all GNUnet default services
  -s, --start                start all GNUnet default services
  -T, --timeout=DELAY        exit with error status if operation does not
                               finish after DELAY
  -v, --version              print the version number

Report bugs to gnunet-developers@gnu.org.
Home page: http://www.gnu.org/s/gnunet/
General help using GNU software: http://www.gnu.org/gethelp/
